# Availability

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Availability`](gmeow-Availability.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Availability>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/calendar`](../../slices/calendar.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A time-scoped statement of an agent's availability over an interval — free, busy, tentative, or out-of-office. The free-busy spine of the calendar layer.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:TimeScopedRelation`](gmeow-TimeScopedRelation.md), [`gufo:Situation`](http://purl.org/nemo/gufo#Situation)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Availability`](gmeow-Availability.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:TimeScopedRelation`](gmeow-TimeScopedRelation.md), [`gufo:Situation`](http://purl.org/nemo/gufo#Situation). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to state whether an agent is free, busy, tentative, or out-of-office over a bounded interval — the iCalendar VFREEBUSY case, reified as a time-scoped situation so the slot and status are queryable.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for attendance at a specific event (use [`gmeow:Participation`](gmeow-Participation.md) / [`gmeow:EventInvitation`](gmeow-EventInvitation.md)) and for a timeless 'usually busy' generalization; an availability holds only across its named interval.

### How to use

- Inherit the time-scope from [`gmeow:TimeScopedRelation`](gmeow-TimeScopedRelation.md): name the [`gmeow:availabilityAgent`](../properties/gmeow-availabilityAgent.md), bound it with a [`gmeow:availabilitySlot`](../properties/gmeow-availabilitySlot.md) interval, and set the [`gmeow:availabilityStatus`](../properties/gmeow-availabilityStatus.md) value.

### Examples

- ex:lillithBusy a [`gmeow:Availability`](gmeow-Availability.md); [`gmeow:availabilityAgent`](../properties/gmeow-availabilityAgent.md) ex:lillith; [`gmeow:availabilitySlot`](../properties/gmeow-availabilitySlot.md) ex:morningSlot; [`gmeow:availabilityStatus`](../properties/gmeow-availabilityStatus.md) [`gmeow:availabilityStatusBusy`](../individuals/gmeow-availabilityStatusBusy.md).
